notes: A deeper teal background, so cards stand out more
Each tab has its own glow in the Modern theme: amber on Money, emerald on Wealth, blue on Plan and mint on Home
The top bar takes a hint of the tab's colour, so it blends with the page beneath it
The top bar is solid, so nothing shows through behind it as you scroll
Home shows your three largest investments with a link to see all on Wealth
Money has arrows to move between months, as well as swiping
Plan offers to set up this year's budget, and shows the growth projection as a range from tough to good years
Each kind of investment has its own icon, and search is a smaller button on the right
Import a bank statement from Money, as CSV or PDF, including password-locked PDFs, read on your phone and never uploaded
Every row is read or listed with the reason it couldn't be, and amounts are checked against the statement's running balance
Anything already recorded is left out, and card bills, loan EMIs, investments, own transfers, cash withdrawals and refunds are left out to begin with, with the reason shown
Categories follow what you chose for the same payee before; choosing one for a payee sets the rest from them
